notes.title: RE: Update 1.5
notes.notes: This update could overwrite some users existing save files, so please make a backup of your save files before updating. They can be found on your main drive under USERS-USER-APPDATA-LOCAL-TheQuietApocalypse-SAVED-SaveGames. Drag the 'SaveGames' folder to your desktop to make a copy. Update the game and, if your save games are not showing, start a new game and complete the first objective so the game creates a save folder. Then shut down, and revisit the location that you copied your save games from earlier. Delete the 'SaveGames' folder that is in there and replace with the one from your deskop.

notes.title: UPDATE 1.5 - JOGGING IS HERE!
notes.notes:
JOGGING IS HERE! Following multiple requests from players, and concerns about transit times between locations, I have now implemented jogging into the game. 'Left Shift' will now put you into the jogging state, which will cut travel times down by approximately 30%. There is a stamina 'cooldown' during which you will have to walk until your stamina regenerates, but this is very short.

This update could overwrite some users existing save files, so please make a backup of your save files before updating. They can be found on your main drive under USERS-USER-APPDATA-LOCAL-TheQuietApocalypse-SAVED-SaveGames. Drag the 'SaveGames' folder to your desktop to make a copy. Update the game and, if your save games are not showing, start a new game and complete the first objective so the game creates a save folder. Then shut down, and revisit the location that you copied your save games from earlier. Delete the 'SaveGames' folder that is in there and replace with the one from your deskop.
